structure.heading: Channel Attribution and Cost per Acquisition (CPA) Performance — Q1 2026
text_content: **Channel Attribution and Cost per Acquisition (CPA) Performance — Q1 2026**

In Q1 2026 the program recorded a total spend of $2,400,000 with 12,000 attributed conversions, yielding an overall blended CPA of $200. Attribution coverage indicates Paid Search and Paid Social accounted for 40% and 20% of attributed conversions respectively (4,800 and 2,400 conversions). These channel shares reflect conversion outcomes measured for January–March 2026 and set the baseline for comparative performance in subsequent quarters.

Paid Search delivered 4,800 attributed conversions at a $120 CPA in Q1 2026, representing 40% of conversions and $576,000 in channel spend. Paid Social delivered 2,400 attributed conversions at a $180 CPA, representing 20% of conversions and $432,000 in channel spend. Combined these two channels accounted for $1,008,000 (42% of total spend); the remaining $1,392,000 (58% of spend) is attributed to other channels or unassigned touchpoints.

Instagram, strengthening server-side event tracking to recover unassigned conversions, and implementing a multi-touch attribution pilot covering at least April–June 2026 to better quantify upper-funnel impacts. We recommend quarterly KPI reviews with channel owners, setting target CPAs by channel (e.g., maintain Paid Search at ≤$120) and gating incremental spend on improved measurement fidelity and validated lift through demonstrated incremental returns before expansion.

structure.heading: Conversion Funnel Efficiency, Brand Awareness Lift, and Q2 2026 Budget Reallocation Plan
text_content: **Conversion Funnel Efficiency, Brand Awareness Lift, and Q2 2026 Budget Reallocation Plan**
B tests on cart abandonment flows, and targeted email retargeting for visitors with product interest but no purchase within seven days to reduce time-to-conversion and improve conversion velocity.

Measured brand awareness rose from 32% in Jan 2026 to 37% in Mar 2026, a +5 percentage point lift that validates recent upper-funnel investments and creative resonance with target cohorts. Survey panels show strongest lift among 25–34 year olds in California and New York. Recommendations: sustain branding impressions through April–June to convert awareness into consideration, and run sequential creative with clear CTAs to accelerate movement down the funnel toward purchase intent.

Content to prioritize high-intent acquisition and organic growth. Implementation steps: 1. Shift pacing and update monthly spend cadence; 2. Reassign creative budgets toward search assets and content calendars; 3. Establish KPIs — Paid Search CPA, organic traffic growth, assisted conversions — with weekly monitoring and mid-quarter review in May 2026.
